product.name: Aura Botanical Pendant
product.subtitle: Preserved Wild Baby’s Breath & 24K Gold Leaf in Crystalline Resin
product.description: An ethereal celebration of impermanence made eternal. Hand-picked wild baby’s breath sprigs and genuine 24-karat gold leaf flakes suspended in optical-grade UV-resistant crystal resin. Finished with an 18k gold-plated brass curb chain.
details: Encapsulates real botanicals harvested at peak bloom
Optical-grade non-yellowing epoxy resin with mirror hand-polish
Hypoallergenic 18k gold-plated brass chain with lobster clasp
Individually poured and cured over 72 meticulous hours

specifications.materials: UV-Stabilized Crystal Clear Epoxy Resin, 18K Gold Plating
specifications.inclusions: Real dried Gypsophila (Baby’s Breath), 24k Gold Leaf Flakes
specifications.hardware: 18" adjustable curb chain with 2" extender (Lead & Nickel free)

careInstructions: Store in a dark, dry pouch away from direct sun to maintain botanical vibrancy.
Wipe gently with a soft microfibre cloth (do not use harsh alcohol cleaners).
Remove before swimming, showering, or spraying fine perfume.

product.name: Verdant Marble Statement Hoops
product.subtitle: Deep Emerald Alcohol Ink & Molten Gold Veins in Sculpted Resin
product.description: Fluid, organic marbling reminiscent of deep forest canopy and subterranean malachite. Rich emerald green alcohol inks react in real-time with metallic gold dust, creating an individual, unrepeatable current within every earring pair.
details: Sculptural geometric hoop silhouette with smooth bevelled contours
Ultra-lightweight resin construction designed for all-day comfort
Surgical grade titanium posts suited for the most sensitive ears
Hand-buffed with carnauba wax to a tactile glass-sheen finish

specifications.materials: Slow-cure Artisanal Resin, Japanese Alcohol Inks, Mica Pigment
specifications.inclusions: Deep emerald pigments, crushed metallic gold dust
specifications.hardware: Hypoallergenic Titanium posts with secure silicone backs

careInstructions: Avoid dropping onto hard stone or tile surfaces.
Polish with dry cotton cloth to restore glass-like lustre.
Keep isolated from sharp metal keys to prevent surface scuffs.

product.name: Nocturne Emerald Coaster Set
product.subtitle: Pair of 2 Hand-Poured Resin Coasters with Gilded Live Edges
product.description: Transform your living space or coffee table into an art salon. Each coaster features fluid swirls of deep forest emerald green, deep espresso smoke, and hand-painted 24k liquid gold leaf along the live organic edges.
details: Heat resistant up to 90°C (perfect for hot morning tea or artisanal pour-over coffee)
Silicone non-slip feet installed on base to prevent glassware sliding
Set of 2 unique sister coasters, complementary yet never matching
Packaged in bespoke raw linen presentation gift box

specifications.materials: Food-safe heat-resistant Epoxy Resin, Metallic Pigments
specifications.inclusions: Alcohol ink marbling, liquid gold edge gilding
specifications.hardware: Clear silicone dampening bumpers affixed to underside

careInstructions: Rinse with mild soapy water and wipe dry. Do not place in dishwasher.
Suitable for hot mugs up to 90°C; do not place boiling pans straight from stove.
